meta.title: اختبار الفصل الأول في اللغة الإنجليزية
topics: family members: father, mother, brother, sister

paper:
Exercise 1 (3 points)

Hello! I am Rami. I am eight. This is my father. This is my mother. This is my sister, Nada. Her bag is pink.

Read and circle: a) Rami is (seven / eight). b) Nada is his (sister / brother). c) Her bag is (pink / blue).

Exercise 2 (3 points)

Match: 1) father   2) mother   3) brother   → a) الأم   b) الأخ   c) الأب

Exercise 3 (4 points)

Write the numbers in letters: 3 → …… ; 5 → …… ; 8 → …… ; 10 → ……
solution:
Exercise 1

Answer keyMarksTotal

a) eight ; b) sister ; c) pink

3×13

Exercise 2

Answer keyMarksTotal

1 → c ; 2 → a ; 3 → b

3×13

Exercise 3

Answer keyMarksTotal

three ; five ; eight ; ten

4×14
